document.title: Build a paragraph: point → explanation → example → result

ask.en: Build the paragraph (Working from home).
ask.kk: Абзацты құрастырыңыз (Working from home).
ask.ru: Соберите абзац (Working from home).

why.en: Point → explanation (This is mainly because) → example (For example) → result (As a result).
why.kk: Дәлел → түсіндірме (This is mainly because) → мысал (For example) → нәтиже (As a result).
why.ru: Аргумент → пояснение (This is mainly because) → пример (For example) → результат (As a result).

items: Firstly, one of the main advantages of remote work is that employees save a considerable amount of time.
This is mainly because they no longer need to commute to an office.
For example, many workers in large cities spend over an hour travelling every day.
As a result, they have more time for family, rest and exercise.

ask.en: Build the paragraph (sugar tax).
ask.kk: Абзацты құрастырыңыз (тәтті салығы).
ask.ru: Соберите абзац (налог на сладкое).

why.en: Same pattern. The example is a specific fact, not a general phrase.
why.kk: Сол сызба. Мысал — жалпы сөз емес, нақты факт.
why.ru: Та же схема. Пример — конкретный факт, а не общая фраза.

items: One of the main reasons why a tax on sugary drinks is justified is that it reduces consumption.
This is because higher prices discourage people from buying unhealthy products.
For instance, after the UK introduced such a levy in 2018, many manufacturers reduced the sugar content of their drinks.
Consequently, overall sugar intake is likely to fall.

ask.en: Build the cause paragraph (Household waste).
ask.kk: Себеп туралы абзацты құрастырыңыз (Household waste).
ask.ru: Соберите абзац о причине (Household waste).

why.en: Cause → why → example → effect.
why.kk: Себеп → неге → мысал → салдар.
why.ru: Причина → почему → пример → следствие.

items: One of the primary causes of this issue is the overuse of packaging.
This is mainly because supermarkets wrap even fresh produce in plastic.
For example, apples and cucumbers are often sold on plastic trays.
As a result, a single shopping trip can generate a large amount of rubbish.

ask.en: Build the solution paragraph.
ask.kk: Шешім туралы абзацты құрастырыңыз.
ask.ru: Соберите абзац о решении.

why.en: Solution → how it works (This would…) → result.
why.kk: Шешім → қалай жұмыс істейді (This would…) → нәтиже.
why.ru: Решение → как сработает (This would…) → результат.

items: To address this issue, several measures could be implemented.
Firstly, governments should charge supermarkets for excessive packaging.
This would encourage companies to use less plastic.
Consequently, the amount of household waste would decline.

ask.en: Build the paragraph (Cashless payments, a drawback).
ask.kk: Абзацты құрастырыңыз (Cashless payments, кемшілік).
ask.ru: Соберите абзац (Cashless payments, минус).

why.en: Body 2 of Adv/Disadv: On the other hand + drawback + explanation + example + result.
why.kk: Adv/Disadv екінші абзацы: On the other hand + кемшілік + түсіндірме + мысал + қорытынды.
why.ru: Второй абзац Adv/Disadv: On the other hand + минус + пояснение + пример + вывод.

items: On the other hand, one major concern is that cashless payments can exclude some groups.
This is mainly because older people and those on low incomes may not have a smartphone or a bank card.
For example, some shops refuse cash, which makes it difficult for these customers to buy basic goods.
Therefore, a fully cashless society could increase inequality.

ask.en: What does ‘For instance, …’ do?
ask.kk: «For instance, …» қандай қызмет атқарады?
ask.ru: Какую функцию выполняет «For instance, …»?

why.en: For example / For instance introduce an example.
why.kk: For example / For instance — мысал.
why.ru: For example / For instance — пример.

ask.en: Paragraph: point → explanation → example. What is missing?
ask.kk: Абзац: дәлел → түсіндірме → мысал. Не жетіспейді?
ask.ru: Абзац: аргумент → пояснение → пример. Чего не хватает?

why.en: Without a result the paragraph stops short, which hurts Coherence and Task Response.
why.kk: Нәтижесіз абзац «үзіліп» қалады, Coherence мен Task Response төмендейді.
why.ru: Без результата абзац «обрывается», страдают Coherence и Task Response.
